passage: Counsellor's log, 14 August. Jeevan (Class 10) came in at lunch, uneasy. He said a rumour has gone round that Mrs Rashmi Nair, the maths teacher, marks down anyone who takes outside tuition. He has watched classmates repeat the same story with new 'proof' each time: a low mark here, a stern look there. He admitted he almost believes it himself, because he has heard it so often.
